race.description: Aitken Rowe Testing Laboratories Country Boosted Hcp (C2)
race.comment: DEE DEE EXPRESS (2) is the horse to beat after finishing second in a Class 3 at this track last start, and she comes back to Class 2 with a proven 1200m profile. Her one poor run at Goulburn is easier to overlook given she raced wide throughout and rebounded immediately. KENNY'S SWANS (3) has been beaten as favourite in both runs this campaign, but the substance is still strong. Ran a head second at this track two back, then third at Cootamundra, and his track-and-trip record keeps him right in the argument. CHOC CHIP (7) has upside after winning a Mdn at this venue first-up despite covering ground, so the rise to this company is the obvious test but she has scope. RIVERBEND UNICORN (6) has mixed recent form and yet the return to 1200m. Weight relief and winning rider back give him a sound each-way platform.
